title.en: Tailor your résumé to a role

body.zh: 贴上岗位描述和你的经历，逐条对照、改写成简历句。只用真实经历，缺什么如实标出。
body.en: Paste a job description and your experience to match and rewrite bullets — real experience only.

prompt.zh: 对照这个岗位和我的真实经历，帮我改简历。
prompt.en: Help me tailor my résumé using the job description and my actual experience.

body.zh: 按岗位预测问题，一题一题模拟，每题答完给点评。
body.en: Predict questions for the role and practise them one at a time, with feedback after each.

prompt.zh: 帮我模拟一次面试，一次问一题。
prompt.en: Run a practice interview with me, one question at a time.

body.zh: 从成长、薪酬、团队、前景等维度打分，比较手上的几个 offer。
body.en: Compare your offers on growth, pay, team, prospects and more.

question.zh: 我有几个 offer，想按个人目标和约束比较。
question.en: Help me compare my offers against my goals and constraints.
